accessibility: Semantic <time datetime> element with a human-readable rendering in the launch timezone; label and status are plain text.
inputs: deadline {deadline_at ISO-8601 with offset | None, timezone IANA name, label, expired_text?} + injected timezone-aware now. A naive deadline_at, a naive now, or an unknown timezone name raises ValueError (an unknown timezone is named in the message).
name: deadline-display
outputs: {html, state: absent|active|expired, deadline_at, timezone}. Absent renders no date or scarcity text; expired never extends or resets the deadline.
